note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them (mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles). Rockstar has never published the list itself. Kind and missable flags are this guide's own classification, derived from the official descriptions — not PSN data. Guides are written in this guide's own words; where no public source has pinned down a method, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is no shortcut: the platinum pops the moment the last trophy unlocks, so follow the roadmap below and clear the potentially missable meditation trophy before you finish Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is unmissable and unlocks as the story starts; just follow the on-screen objectives.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the chapter-complete trophy unlocks. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot — it may be the one missable trophy in the game (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progress only; keep a manual save at the start of each chapter in case you ever want to replay a stretch.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Unmissable story progress — it unlocks when the chapter's last mission ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Unmissable story progress — it unlocks when the chapter's last mission ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Unmissable; it unlocks with the story's ending, so there is nothing extra to prepare.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission list. Unmissable as part of the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable as part of the story; it is one of the big set-piece heists.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable as part of the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable as part of the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable as part of the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable as part of the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: finish the story, all Strangers & Freaks strands, all activities, collectibles and challenges the completion counter tracks. Check the in-game stats page to see what is still missing. This is the longest grind — about 200 hours in total to the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and air time in vehicles all count toward the total. Stunt jumps around Leonida are the reliable way to build the count; it accumulates across the whole playthrough, so chip away at it whenever you drive.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, golf, shooting range, races, drone races, arcade, bowling, meditation and the remaining activity the game lists. You only need to try each once, not win — so do this early and cheaply.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's weapon pattern and the gold threshold shown in the range menu, then work through the list one weapon at a time. This is a skill grind, not a luck one — expect several sessions.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race; winning once per location is enough, so learn each course's corners and cut them clean.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — road, off-road or water races all count, as long as each race is a different event. Replays of the same race do not add to the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish with Cal when the challenge is offered and outscore him; better bait and steadier reeling help more than speed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game to its end in any arcade. Pick the shortest cabinet and play it through — one completion is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Work through Andy's missions in order; the strand ends with his final mission, and it counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's Strangers & Freaks strand. Work through Kenton's missions in order; the strand ends with his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Work through Billy's missions in order; the strand ends with his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more strands than 8, so you can skip the ones you dislike; track which strands are finished in the mission log and mop up the rest after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Work through Randy's missions in order; the strand ends with his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's Strangers & Freaks strand. Work through Tyrone's missions in order; the strand ends with his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida, including the balcony spot in Chapter 1. This is the only trophy any guide flags as potentially missable: if the Chapter 1 balcony spot can only be reached in Chapter 1, keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until you confirm otherwise. No source has published the full spot list yet, so check each spot as you find it and do not leave Chapter 1 without meditating on the balcony.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at the animal; the exact animal and location are not yet pinned down by any public source — follow Bret's missions and check the cited sources for updates rather than hunting blind.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when every card in it is found. No public source has published full card locations yet, so collect as you explore and check the cited sources for a map.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo and share feature — open it at 100 different spots across the map. The count is tracked per location, so keep moving to new areas rather than reusing the same spot.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small tasks listed in the challenges menu; pick the quickest ones first and let the count build over the playthrough — most players reach 50 naturally before the platinum.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while playing with your partner, then escape the heat. Get the heat up to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route between three nearby shops, rob each in turn, and keep moving — do not let the wanted level drop between robberies, or the chain breaks.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Simply drive or enter 100 different vehicles; the discovery counter tracks each new model you get into, so try everything you pass — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends — a busy shootout is a better attempt than a quiet one.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down by any public source; the trophy's name points to leaving the airport in an unplanned way, most likely by aircraft. Treat this as unconfirmed until a source pins it down.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhino is the tank, so the trophy involves it — but no public source has pinned down the exact requirement yet. Do not grind blindly; check the cited sources before spending time on it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, take the goods, and leave before any alarm — one detection voids the attempt, so save first.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault robbery ends with an escape; five successful vault jobs earn this. Plan the getaway before you go in — the escape counts as much as the robbery.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cash, and get away clean — one successful truck job is enough.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive and walk through every named area until the map is fully revealed; the in-game map shows which regions are still unexplored, so sweep the edges last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs its own illegal operation; hit one per gang until every gang is covered.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean Beach spot, enjoy a cocktail there, and the trophy pops — a quiet moment, no combat needed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through the showroom's frontage to break out — the classic GTA showroom smash, done on purpose.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at that alley; a follow-through means completing your throw — just play a full game there and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description gives no concrete requirement, and no public source has pinned down the trigger yet — this guide lists it as unconfirmed rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The description is deliberately vague and no public source has pinned down the exact choice or trigger yet — listed here as unconfirmed rather than guessed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no public source has pinned down what yet — listed here as unconfirmed rather than guessed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description hints at a strange or hidden event, but no public source has pinned down the trigger yet — listed here as unconfirmed rather than guessed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, use a melee attack to knock down bowling pins — the bowling alley's pins are the target, so line up a slow pass past them.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through contacts until $250,000 is cleaned — keep robbing and laundering, and the total builds up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and anything else; spending accumulates across every shop in the game, so it comes naturally if you shop as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property listed for sale across Leonida; you will need the money first, so this is a late-game cleanup trophy — save up, then buy them all in one sweep.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register vehicles you own or find, and repeat until 10 are registered.
